title: Factorial postzygotic viability intervention to test expression-order survival sensitivity

existing_evidence.prior_confirmatory_interaction: original 64-history near-far DID practically equivalent at +/-0.05
existing_evidence.positive_signal_rank: post-outcome exploratory, positive common absolute occupancy with greater selfed recruits, lower outcross recruits

postzygotic_viability_factorial.interpretation: retain fraction of genetically ordinary expected viable selfed and expected outcross seeds after reproduction, immediately before recruitment
postzygotic_viability_factorial.check: offspring ledger viable maternal = sum donor viable outcross per recipient + viable selfed; derived paternal = sum outcross as donor + viable selfed; both never increase over baseline
postzygotic_viability_factorial.caveat: reduced offspring viability is a postzygotic experimental intervention, not a change to pollen transfer, genotype, or natural gene expression order

estimand.history_unit: 64 independent visitor histories; paired assignment contrasts within each history
estimand.common_occupancy_by_arm: average the A-first minus I-first difference across near/far historical environments, all 4 mating settings, 7 log-weighted budgets, 2 future visitor regimes, and 2 nested demographic repeats, with 8-founder capacity-8 as primary
mandatory_secondary: factorial interaction = Delta_baseline - Delta_self - Delta_outcross + Delta_both
near and far absolute occupancy by assignment
t0 payoff and 80-step realized recruit counts
estimand.positive_result: only if two-sided 95% bootstrap interval excludes 0 AND absolute history mean tau >= 0.005
estimand.practically_equivalent: only if full two-sided 95% interval strictly within (-0.005,+0.005)
estimand.directional_hypothesis: attenuating selfed viable offspring may reduce the A-first absolute survival contrast; this direction is exploratory and is not a one-sided gate

scientific_boundaries: Existing 64 visitor histories are already observed; this conditional future intervention is new, but not a novel unexposed historical cohort.
The old 64-history window test remains failed and pooled DID equivalence is not retroactively redefined.
A difference in schedule effects between viability gates establishes susceptibility of a model-specific total schedule effect to controlled gate, not natural indirect mediation.
Changing selfed seed survival may affect density and genotype selection; do not call the result solely direct reproductive assurance mediation.
Do not condition primary on t400 survival, genotype crossing class, or final survival.
Never treat 229376 future branches as independent ecological replicates.
The viability-attenuation fractions are synthetic, not calibrated field estimates.
Unattenuated exact replay and original frozen source hashes must pass before any affected future outcomes are considered.
